item.title: Version 4.6.0
item.description:
What's new in 4.6.0

Meet Peek. The pixel crab has retired. Peek is a tiny 3D character, rendered live in Metal, who breathes, blinks, glances at you and climbs out of the notch the more a session needs you. Eight finishes: Obsidian, Chrome, Gold, Holo, Neon, Porcelain, Gummy and Frosted.

A new island. Cards, the pill and the menu now share one design. Usage at a glance (5-hour ring, resets, pace forecast, heads-ups at 80% and 95%), each session with its own colour and task name, and a menu that opens like the notch does.

Safer approvals. Notch So Good only ever approves a tool call when you click Allow. Chained shell commands never ride on an allow rule.

This update can't be installed automatically. Download it from the release page below, or run brew upgrade notch-so-good.
